audience: Staffing firms that book temporary workers to sites in TempClock

useCases.title: See who is on site now
useCases.text: Count the workers on site right now, per site or in total. Include the worker list or only the totals.

useCases.title: Review completed shifts
useCases.text: List completed shifts of a worker or a site in a date range. Pay and charge figures are not included.

useCases.title: Check the bookings for next week
useCases.text: List shift bookings with worker, site, date, times and status, and read the worker records behind them.

useCases.title: Find a worker or site by id
useCases.text: Look up one worker or one site by its id, then use that id in the other lookups.
